changes.title: Conversation changes
changes.currentEmpty: No recorded edits in this turn yet
changes.latestEmpty: No recorded edits in the latest turn
changes.jumpNamed: Jump to edit {{number}} of {{file}} in the conversation
changes.sequentialEdits: Edits appear in recorded order. Each entry shows that edit, not a combined file diff.
changes.noChanges: No recorded file edits in this selection.
changes.partialHistory: Earlier conversation messages are not loaded yet.
changes.recordedOnly: Recorded file edits from this conversation. Entries may contain edited fragments; they do not describe every change currently on disk.
changes.contextUnavailable: That edit is no longer in the loaded conversation. Reload the history and try again.
changes.unknownBefore: The earlier content was not recorded, so a before-and-after diff is unavailable.
changes.largeComparison: This edit is large. Review its recorded before and after content in pages.
changes.noRecordedContent: This file operation was recorded without its content. Jump to the conversation for context.
changes.identical: The recorded before and after content are identical.
changes.pagedContent: Content is paginated. Use Next to review the remaining content.

modelIdentity.contextHint: 1M is context capacity, not a model version.

sessionActions.busy: Wait for this conversation to stop before branching or rewinding.
sessionActions.notSaved: This message is not yet available in saved Claude history.
sessionActions.sideChatDescription: Start a separate, ongoing conversation with the history through this message. The main conversation keeps its own context.
sessionActions.sharedFiles: The side chat runs on the same remote and uses the same project files. File edits are shared between the two conversations. Earlier file checkpoints are not copied into the side chat.

modeDescriptions.conversation: Keep context through this user message and discard the following conversation context. Leave files unchanged.
modeDescriptions.files: Restore files to the checkpoint associated with this message. Keep all conversation context.
modeDescriptions.both: Keep context through this message and restore its file checkpoint.

sessionActions.contextBoundary: This user message stays in context; Claude’s later replies and subsequent messages are removed from the context used for the next turn. You do not need to resend the selected message.
sessionActions.backup: The previous full conversation is kept as an archived backup.
sessionActions.fileScope: File recovery covers changes tracked by Claude’s native editing checkpoints. It cannot guarantee undoing shell commands, experiment scripts, database operations, or edits from another conversation. Old conversations without saved checkpoints may not support file recovery.
sessionActions.unavailable: No usable checkpoint is available for this restore.
sessionActions.noFiles: The checkpoint reports no file changes to restore.
sessionActions.expired: This preview has expired. Refresh it before restoring.
sessionActions.refreshFailed: The context was restored, but the updated history could not be loaded. Refresh this conversation before continuing.
sessionActions.checkpointAfterRewind: The restored context copy does not inherit earlier file checkpoints.
sessionActions.branchWhileRunning: The main conversation is running. You can branch from a saved message; rewinding must wait until it stops.

usage.title: Tokens and estimated cost
usage.localEstimate: Local estimate reported by the existing Claude process.
usage.lastSampling: Latest main sampling window; approximate current context, not cumulative work.
usage.noContext: No reliable context observation yet. Cumulative consumption is never substituted.
usage.partialTurn: Observed requests only; internal calls or unreported usage may be missing.
usage.historicalPartial: Historical totals cover recoverable request records. Unrecorded internal work and historical prices remain unknown.
usage.inherited: Copied branch context is excluded from this conversation’s consumed totals.
usage.accountingPartial: Some usage could not be fully reconciled; the displayed totals include the recorded portion.
usage.explanation: Repeated cache reads count toward consumption each time, but occupy the context only once per sampling request. Thinking is already included in output. SDK costs are estimates, not invoices. Compaction and rewind do not erase spent tokens or cost. One turn covers one user send, including Workflow follow-ups and subagents.
usage.postCompact: Context reported after compaction; unavailable counts remain unknown.
usage.legacyExplanation: This connection has not supplied verified Claude accounting. The legacy value may mix individual request usage with multiple requests, so it cannot confirm current context, turn consumption or conversation totals.
usage.awaitingExplanation: No verified usage has been received for this conversation yet. Missing statistics do not mean zero consumption.
usage.legacyRefresh: After this machine’s CloudCLI update finishes, refresh the page. Verified statistics show current context, the current turn and whole conversation separately; incomplete history remains labelled.
